title.zh: 富国银行探索与 Kraken 母公司 Payward 的加密流动性合作
title.en: Wells Fargo Explores Crypto Liquidity Partnership With Kraken Parent Payward

current_state.zh: 富国银行正与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈合作，探讨由Payward为其数字资产交易业务提供流动性、市场深度和交易执行支持；双方仍在谈判，尚未达成最终协议。
current_state.en: Wells Fargo is in talks with Kraken parent Payward to have Payward supply liquidity, market depth and trade execution for the bank's digital asset trading business; negotiations are ongoing and no final agreement has been reached.

updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，富国银行正在探索与 Kraken 母公司 Payward 建立加密流动性合作伙伴关系，显示这家美国大型银行对数字资产市场基础设施的机构兴趣持续。
updates.what_changed_en: Wells Fargo is reportedly exploring a crypto liquidity partnership with Payward, the parent company of Kraken, signaling continued institutional interest from a major US bank in digital-asset market infrastructure.

updates.title_en: 富国银行正与与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈合作，或借助其拓展加密交易业务
updates.what_changed_zh: 富国银行与Payward的洽谈已细化，Payward或将为富国银行的数字资产交易业务提供市场深度和交易执行支持，以帮助其避免自建完整交易基础设施；双方仍在谈判，尚未达成最终协议。
updates.what_changed_en: Wells Fargo's talks with Payward have become more specific: Payward may provide market depth and trade execution for Wells Fargo's digital asset trading business, helping the bank avoid building full trading infrastructure from scratch; talks are ongoing and no final agreement has been reached.

updates.current_state_en: Wells Fargo is in talks with Kraken parent Payward to have Payward supply liquidity, market depth and trade execution for the bank's digital asset trading business; negotiations are ongoing and no final agreement has been reached.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Wells Fargo is in talks with Kraken parent Payward to have it supply market depth and trade execution for the bank's digital asset trading business, avoiding the need to build its own trading infrastructure.
